description: This script automates the installation, configuration, and testing of the OpenClaw AI platform, handling dependencies, environment setup, model configuration, and running a series of agent interactions for end-to-end testing.

methods.name: set_image_model
methods.description: Tries to set the image model for a given profile using a list of candidate models.

methods.name: set_agent_model
methods.description: Tries to set the agent model for a given profile using a list of candidate models.

methods.name: write_png_lr_rg
methods.description: Generates a PNG image file with specific alternating color patterns.

methods.name: run_agent_turn
methods.description: Runs an agent turn with provided prompt and saves JSON output.

methods.name: assert_agent_json_has_text
methods.description: Checks whether the agent JSON output contains text payloads.

methods.name: assert_agent_json_ok
methods.description: Validates the agent JSON output for success status and provider.

methods.name: extract_matching_text
methods.description: Extracts specific text from agent JSON output, matching expected content.

methods.name: assert_session_used_tools
methods.description: Checks that the session transcript includes specific tool usage.

methods.name: run_profile
methods.description: Performs end-to-end setup and testing of an agent profile, including model configuration, session interaction, and verification.
